provenance.venue: Journal of Experimental Psychology: Human Perception and Performance

conditions: rapid serial visual stream with a partially specified first target and a later fully specified probe
task: identify the first target and detect whether a specified later probe is present
temporal_scope: probe position ranges from immediately after the target through several hundred milliseconds later

nodes.description: requirement to identify the partially specified first target
continued serial visual stimulation following the first target
elapsed time from first-target presentation to the second probe
probability of correctly detecting the specified later probe
brief blank interval inserted after the first target in control conditions
two-event rapid-serial procedure measuring second-probe detection as a function of delay and first-target processing
correct judgment of presence or absence of the later specified probe
temporarily unavailable processing resource inferred from the delay-specific second-probe deficit

relations.description: second-probe detection drops selectively at intermediate posttarget delays when first-target identification and continuing stream processing are required
inserting a brief posttarget blank removes or reduces the temporary second-probe deficit
the source interprets the transient deficit as a temporary limit during completion of first-target processing
the rapid-serial two-event procedure measures the time course of the temporary deficit
outcome is evaluated by correct presence/absence judgment for the probe
